name: Constronics Infra Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, Constronics India Ltd does trading of Construction and Building Materials[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
CIL used to be a pharma company but in FY18, due to change in management,  company changed its main object to Construction and Infrastructure sector and trading in materials for construction purpose

pros: Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 136 days to 73.2 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Earnings include an other income of Rs.2.40 Cr.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -7.84%
